title: Le Carnaval De Venise
identity: The current catalog entry is an alto-saxophone-and-piano version of Demersseman’s Le Carnaval de Venise. Keiser/Southern Music describes a separate alto saxophone and band edition, about six minutes, with saxophone part edited by Fred Hemke and orchestration by Herbert Clarke/R. Mark Rogers; that source confirms a band version but not the piano edition.

evidence.claim: Identifies alto sax and band edition, approximate duration and editorial/arrangement credits; not the piano version.

gaps: Piano edition publisher/version and notation were not verified.
